posts.text: The current standalone capacity is reportedly sufficient to support a topline of roughly ₹600 crore. Given the current growth trajectory, the company appears well-positioned to hit this milestone within the next two years. This new Assam land acquisition seems to be a proactive move to build the infrastructure required for the next leg of growth beyond that ₹600 crore mark.
